title.note: Game title kept in Latin (glossary keep); Roblox's Hindi pages keep game titles in Latin too.
title.blind_remark: left in English, Latin script; not translated

hud.cast.note: 'Throw', the polite imperative of काँटा फेंकना (to cast the line). Avoided transliterated कास्ट, which reads as 'caste'.

hud.reel.note: 'Pull (it) in'. Transliterated रील now reads as Instagram Reels, so the Hindi verb is used; same verb in pass.auto_reel.

hud.bait_left.note: Label form so 0, 1 and many all read right; चारा is the everyday word for fishing bait.

hud.backpack.note: Kids call a backpack बैग (guide); बस्ता feels dated.

catch.success.note: Colon keeps the verb clear of the fish name's gender, as the guide's egg.hatched pattern does. Loan rarity words (रेयर, मिथिक) do not inflect before the name.

catch.escaped.note: Hindi needs a subject, so 'it' becomes the generic मछली (fish); 'ran off' is how a kid would say it.

catch.new_record.note: kg written as किलो, the everyday Hindi unit word; the decimal point in {weight} is correct for hi-in.

fish.golden_carp.note: 'Golden carp'; कार्प is the usual Hindi name for the species. Not सुनहरी मछली, which means goldfish. Some kids may not know कार्प.

fish.lantern_eel.note: लालटेन (lantern) keeps the glowing-lantern idea; ईल is the word Hindi uses for eel (इलेक्ट्रिक ईल). The Latin title no longer echoes it for Hindi readers.

rarity.mythic.note: Transliterated like the guide's लेजेंडरी and रेयर: Hinglish gamer rarity words that never inflect. Hindi पौराणिक reads textbook and religious. Ranks above लेजेंडरी by gamer convention.
rarity.mythic.blind_remark: English word 'mythic' spelled out in Devanagari, not a Hindi word; players who don't know the English term may not understand it

shop.rods.note: Fishing rod is रॉड in everyday Hindi; plural form is the same. बंसी is old-fashioned and also means flute.

shop.equip.note: 'Use' as the action, paired with shop.equipped 'in use'. Exactly at the 10 budget as the lint counts; letters render wider, so check the button in Studio.

shop.equipped.note: 'In use': a state label with no gender agreement.

shop.buy_robux.note: Guide reference pattern; SOV order puts the price first.
shop.buy_robux.blind_remark: Robux kept in Latin script inside Devanagari text

pass.auto_reel.note: Same verb as hud.reel with the ऑटो- prefix Hindi phone UIs use (ऑटो-प्ले). Hyphen kept so it does not read as 'pull the auto-rickshaw'. Rejected: ऑटो रील (reads as Instagram Reels) and अपने-आप खींचें (can read as 'pull it yourself'). The Creator Hub pass name should match.
pass.auto_reel.blind_remark: awkward as a product name: English 'auto' in Devanagari plus a polite command form of 'pull', so it reads like an instruction rather than a name

pass.lucky_bait.text: लकी चारा रेयर मछली पकड़ने का चांस दोगुना कर देता है!
pass.lucky_bait.note: चांस is the everyday Hinglish word for odds (मौका also works); 'your' dropped as Hindi implies it. Developer: Hindi falls back to Regular-weight Noto, so check the bold actually shows.
pass.lucky_bait.blind_remark: casual Hinglish: 'lucky', 'rare' and 'chance' are English words written in Devanagari

sell.done.note: Label form: a sentence verb would agree with the counts and break at 1 (1 मछली बेची / 5 मछलियाँ बेचीं, 1 कॉइन मिला / 5 कॉइन मिले). Reads 'Fish sold: 12. Earned: 340 coins!'.

sell.prompt.blind_remark: key letter E in Latin script inside Devanagari text

ascend.button.note: Transliterated like the guide's रीबर्थ; Hindi words (उत्थान, आरोहण) read religious or like climbing. Kids may know the word less well than रीबर्थ.
ascend.button.blind_remark: English word 'ascend' spelled out in Devanagari, not a Hindi word; most Hindi players will not know what it means

ascend.confirm.text: अभी असेंड करें? आपको फिर से शुरू करना होगा, लेकिन रेयर मछली {bonus}% ज़्यादा बार मिलेगी.
ascend.confirm.note: को-construction keeps the reader's gender out; 'catch rare fish more often' becomes 'you will get rare fish more often'.
ascend.confirm.blind_remark: 'ascend' is English in Devanagari and likely not understood

weather.storm.text: तूफ़ान आ रहा है! रेयर मछलियाँ चारा खा रही हैं.
weather.storm.note: 'biting' rendered as 'taking the bait' (चारा खाना), the fishing sense.

quest.title.note: Guide term for quests (Roblox's Hindi Play Store text uses मिशन).

quest.catch_n.text: चाँदनी खाड़ी में {n} बार मछली पकड़ें
quest.catch_n.note: Label form for n: मछली changes to मछलियाँ for more than one, so '{n} मछली' would be wrong for most values. चाँदनी खाड़ी = Moonlit Bay (glossary translate).
quest.catch_n.review_reason: The trailing label ": {n}" reads like a progress count rather than the target (the blind back-translation could not tell which); "{n} बार" (n times) puts the number in the instruction and stays correct for n = 1 because बार never changes form.

quest.claim.note: Guide term; never दावा करें (a legal claim).

friends.boost.text: दोस्तों के साथ मछली पकड़ने पर +{percent}% लक मिलता है
friends.boost.note: लक (luck) is the Hinglish word that matches लकी in Lucky Bait, as the glossary asks for one word; किस्मत is the pure-Hindi alternative.

trade.sent.note: Passive agrees with रिक्वेस्ट (feminine), so the player's gender never shows.

trade.accept.text: {player} ने आपकी ट्रेड रिक्वेस्ट मान ली
trade.accept.note: ने-construction: the verb agrees with रिक्वेस्ट, not the player, so it works for any gender. 'your trade' made explicit as 'your trade request' per context.

codes.enter.note: Guide reference for typing a code in.

codes.redeemed.text: कोड रिडीम हो गया! अपने इनाम का मज़ा लें.

afk.kicked.text: आपने बहुत देर तक कुछ नहीं किया, इसलिए मछली पकड़ना रुक गया.
afk.kicked.note: 'You did nothing for too long': the ने-construction avoids the reader-gendered थे/थीं that 'you were idle' would need. No mention of removal, as in the source.

settings.sfx.note: Usual game-settings term; ध्वनि प्रभाव reads textbook.

event.ends.note: होगा agrees with the implied इवेंट or तूफ़ान (both masculine). Developer: {time} arrives as '2d 4h'; Hindi players expect '2 दिन 4 घं' (CLDR narrow), so format it per locale if possible.

daily.streak.text: लगातार {day} दिन की स्ट्रीक! और इनाम के लिए कल फिर आएँ.
daily.streak.note: स्ट्रीक is the Snapchat/Duolingo word; लगातार ('in a row') makes it clear to kids who don't know it. '{day} दिन' is correct for 1 and many. 'for more' made explicit as more rewards (इनाम).
daily.streak.blind_remark: 'streak' is English in Devanagari and redundant with the Hindi word for 'consecutive' before it

tip.night.text: टिप: कुछ मछलियाँ सिर्फ़ रात में चारा खाती हैं.
tip.night.note: टिप: is the casual label; सुझाव/युक्ति read formal. 'bite' rendered as 'take the bait', as in weather.storm.

group.join.text: हमारी कम्यूनिटी जॉइन करें और 50 फ़्री चारे पाएँ!
group.join.note: कम्यूनिटी is Roblox's Hindi word for groups; हमारी ('our') is how Hindi says 'the studio's group', as in the guide's reference. चारे is the counted plural of चारा, right for the fixed 50.
group.join.blind_remark: heavy Hinglish: 'community', 'join' and 'free' are English words in Devanagari; the plural 'chaare' treats bait as countable, slightly odd

leaderboard.biggest.note: 'Heaviest fish', since the board ranks by weight; सबसे बड़ी पकड़ reads like a police seizure in news Hindi.
